query: CHP olağanüstü kurultay çağrı heyeti Sulh Hukuk Mahkemesi başvuru karar - latest status as of late June / early July 2026. Has Özgür Özel's team filed the application under Civil Code Art 75 requesting appointment of a 3-person çağrı heyeti to convene a CHP extraordinary congress? Has any court issued a decision?
answer:
I've completed the research. Here's the bottom line:

**Has the application been filed?** Yes. Özgür Özel's CHP administration filed the application at the **Ankara Sulh Hukuk Mahkemesi** on **July 14, 2026** under **Turkish Civil Code Article 75**, requesting appointment of a **three-person çağrı heyeti** to convene the extraordinary congress.

**Has a court issued a decision?** No. As of the reporting window (mid-to-late July 2026), no decision had been rendered. The judicial recess (adli tatil) began July 20, 2026, pushing the matter to September 2026.

**Key nuance on the question's timeframe:** The question asks about "late June / early July 2026," but the actual court filing came on **July 14**. In late June/early July, only the June 17 delegate-signature submission (833 delegates) had occurred — the Art. 75 court application had not yet been filed at that earlier point.
